name: skills-practice-plugin
description: Design and persist deliberate-practice skills, rubrics, and questions through Skills Practice.

interface.shortDescription: Design deliberate practice with persistent history
interface.longDescription: Turn a learning goal or application-modeling exercise into a minimal trainable skill tree, an observable point-based rubric, and a reusable first question stored in Skills Practice.
defaultPrompt: Turn my practice goal into a skill, rubric, and first question.
Model this application domain as a deliberate-practice exercise.
